## IS5542 M01 输出分布评估译名与边界

输出分布评估（Distributional Evaluation）指在多次输出和多种情境下评价结果分布，不是将计算分散到多台机器的“分布式计算”。对应IS5542 M01 §2.9.1，可与IS6400／EF5560的分组评估、误差及分母口径对照；不把分组评估等同公平的完整定义。

## M01 本次来源边界更正（无新增DDL）

M01考核组件权重与CA门槛不能因合计50%而视为无关。目录信息在此承接2026-09-09历史转述，本轮URL响应不是目录PDF；讲义权重与题型暂定值可在原件核对，当前正式录分规则待核。本次未新增截止、提交渠道或本人提交／评分，现有已确认后续通知保持。

operations.old: | 首字延迟 | Time To First Token (TTFT) | The delay before the response begins (prefill). | M01 §2.8.3 |
operations.new: | 首字延迟 | Time To First Token (TTFT) | Time from request to first visible token, including network, queueing, optional retrieval/tools, prefill, and first-token decoding. | M01 §2.8.3 |

operations.old: | 批处理 | Batching | Grouping requests to raise fleet utilization, **at the cost of per-request latency**. | M01 §2.8.6 |
operations.new: | 批处理 | Batching | Grouping requests can improve utilization and may add batch-formation delay; net per-request latency depends on workload and scheduling. | M01 §2.8.6 |

operations.old: | 分布式评估 | Distributional Evaluation | Repeated evaluation across scenarios rather than one expected response. **"A single successful demonstration tells us almost nothing about reliability."** | M01 §2.9.1 |
operations.new: | 输出分布评估 | Distributional Evaluation | Repeated evaluation across outputs and scenarios; this is not distributed computation. A single successful demo does not establish reliability across the target workload. | M01 §2.9.1 |

operations.old: | RAG | Retrieval-Augmented Generation | Grounding generation in retrieved, approved **external** evidence. 🎙️ Unlike reasoning, it **can** reduce hallucination because the evidence is verified by humans. | M01 §2.9.3 |
operations.new: | RAG | Retrieval-Augmented Generation | Uses retrieved evidence to ground generation. Its effect depends on source validity, retrieval and faithful use; tools, constraints and human verification can also reduce some errors. | M01 §2.9.3 |

operations.old: | 确定性 vs 概率式 | Deterministic vs Probabilistic | Deterministic systems follow predefined logic and can be tested exhaustively; probabilistic systems vary with sampling, context and model updates, so **testing must focus on distributions of outcomes**. | M01 §2.9.1 |
operations.new: | 确定性 vs 概率式 | Deterministic vs Probabilistic | Fixed deterministic logic is reproducible under fixed state and configuration; traditional software can still vary through state, concurrency and external services. Generative systems additionally require evaluation of output distributions. | M01 §2.9.1 |

## M01 本次机制补充的定位

矩阵／向量、卷积／ReLU／池化及softmax在M01 §2.4.3搭桥；点积、转置、单位矩阵在§2.5.3复做；自然对数、交叉熵、梯度及学习率在§2.6.1说明。它们是笔记教学补充，不冒称讲义实验参数或新模型训练。人工复核包括真实证据核验、拒绝／升级权与责任主体；复合AI不自动等同神经符号AI。
M01 §2.8.5的中间迷失图纵轴为任务准确率，不是内部注意力权重；闭卷基线（closed-book baseline）指不给文档的任务对照。课件近似读数56%基线／中部约47%不推广为所有模型固定值。

## M01 本次依赖登记与复用

本篇按高中知识起点，就地解释数据／标签、模型／参数、训练／推理，继而矩阵乘加→卷积／softmax→token与嵌入→带遮罩注意力／多头／归一化→采样与EOS／预算停止→交叉熵与一次偏置更新。旧L0或跨课首现登记只定位，不证明掌握、也不免除当前核心操作。范数与余弦相似度在§2.9.3服务于退款证据排序；所有玩具数字与真实原件结果分开。不改历史首现或本人学习字段。
